item.title: Asthma Symptoms Linked to Hidden Risks Inside the Home
item.description: Indoor asthma triggers such as smoking, poor ventilation, and mould are strongly linked to worse symptoms and daily limitations, a large study finds. The post Asthma Symptoms Linked to Hidden Risks Inside the Home appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: RPR Predicts Acute Kidney Injury After Cardiac Surgery
item.description: Elevated red cell distribution width-to-platelet ratio predicts cardiac surgery-associated acute kidney injury and improves risk stratification. The post RPR Predicts Acute Kidney Injury After Cardiac Surgery appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI-Powered Liquid Biopsy Boosts Brain Tumour Diagnosis
item.description: A new AI-powered cerebrospinal fluid liquid biopsy accurately classifies brain tumours using tiny DNA fragments, offering less invasive diagnostics. The post AI-Powered Liquid Biopsy Boosts Brain Tumour Diagnosis appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Europe Leads the Charge in Global Tobacco Use
item.description: The WHO European Region is set to maintain its status as having the world’s highest tobacco use by 2030. The post Europe Leads the Charge in Global Tobacco Use appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI and digital twins offer hope for rare disease research
item.description: Organisations like Phesi are leveraging digital patient profiles to create digital twins for even the rarest diseases. The post AI and digital twins offer hope for rare disease research appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Slower Walkers at Higher Risk of Depression
item.description: Slower gait speed is significantly associated with a higher risk of incident depression, a 2026 study has found. The post Slower Walkers at Higher Risk of Depression appeared first on European Medical Journal.
